name: Daily Maintenance — Blu Q Mate
source: KB: blu-q / Mate Blu Q Daily Maintenance
intro: One task per day, about 15 minutes. Check today's day and complete the matching task. Tuesday snorkel work may take longer — clock in for dock time if needed.

items.label: Tuesday: Snorkel inventory and repair — restock from dockbox if low

help.title: Snorkel inventory
help.body: Check all snorkel gear for damage. Restock masks, snorkels, and fins from the dockbox if quantities are low. Repair damaged bite tabs, buckles, etc. This task may take longer than 15 minutes — clock in for dock time.

help.title: Food surface cleaning
help.body: Thoroughly clean all food prep and serving surfaces. Sanitize cutting boards, counters, and any areas where food is handled.

items.label: Photo of food surfaces after cleaning (optional)

help.title: Cushion cleaning
help.body: Scrub cushions thoroughly, hang to dry so they don't stink. Spot clean any stains.

items.label: Saturday: Deep clean head (behind toilet too!)
Photo of head after deep clean (optional)
items.placeholder: Document deep-cleaned head including behind toilet

items.label: Sunday: Clean boat towels — wring on roof stanchion

completion.notes_prompt: Only check today's task. Any supplies needed? Gear repairs outstanding?
